Title: Azure Boards - New enhancements to Delivery Plans 2.0

Body.Content:
With this sprint update, we're enhancing the Delivery Plans 2.0 experience with new condensed views and rollup information. We're also introducing Manual Validation and a new uses statement for pre-declaring resources in YAML pipelines.

Other key features to enhance the overall user experience are now available:
 

Azure Boards

  • Delivery Plans: Rollup Information
  • Delivery Plans: Condensed views

Azure Pipelines

  • "uses" statement for pre-declaring resources
  • Manual Validation for YAML pipelines
